question: Where is the nearest museum you’d find going toward Hall Christmas Tree Farm, Glen Gardner, NJ starting at 70 Park Avenue Hotel, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979628 40.74986)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.923734 40.717256)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979628 40.74986)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979628 40.74986)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: 70 Park Avenue Hotel, New York, NY
